title: veronica anagallis-aquatica subsp. michauxii
intro: Veronica anagallis-aquatica subsp. michauxii, commonly known as Blue Water Speedwell, is a plant species in the Veronicaceae family. It is a perennial aquatic plant native to North America, used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been attributed to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Blue Water Speedwell include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
